complianceSection.card1Desc: You maintain full control of your assets at all times. Oxford Financial Ads operates as a non-custodial platform where your funds remain in your wallet under your private key control. Smart contracts execute trades according to predefined parameters without third-party custody.
complianceSection.card2Desc: All strategy executions are governed by audited smart contracts deployed on Arbitrum Layer-2. Automated protocols handle trade execution, position management, and rebalancing according to algorithmic parameters without human intervention or discretionary control.
complianceSection.card3Desc: Your connected wallet retains withdrawal rights at all times. You can disconnect, withdraw partial or full balances, and exit strategies according to smart contract parameters. No lock-up periods or withdrawal restrictions beyond standard blockchain confirmation times.
complianceSection.card4Desc: All projected performance scenarios are simulations based on historical data and algorithmic models. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Cryptocurrency markets are highly volatile and involve substantial risk of loss. Only allocate capital you can afford to lose.
complianceSection.feature1: Smart Selection: Users can view the maximum possible profit per package (e.g., a $100 package progress bar shows 0 to $150).
complianceSection.feature2: Auto-Upgrade Option: Users can upgrade to a larger package anytime by purchasing the new package.
complianceSection.feature3: Badge System: Each package has a badge or medal based on its name (e.g., $10 = 'Micro', $100,000 = 'Sovereign').
complianceSection.feature4: When a user's profit reaches 150%, the package card shows Expired and the withdrawal button is locked until a new package is purchased.
complianceSection.legalText: Oxford Financial Ads provides algorithmic trading infrastructure and does not offer investment advice, financial planning, or portfolio management services. This platform is intended for sophisticated users who understand blockchain technology and cryptocurrency market risks. Participation constitutes acceptance of all inherent smart contract, market, technological, and regulatory risks. Consult independent legal, tax, and financial advisors before participating.

privacyPolicy.questionsText: If you have any questions about these Privacy Policy, please contact us:

sections.s1_c1: Since Oxford Financial Ads is a decentralized platform, we do not collect your personal files like traditional banks.
sections.s1_c2: Wallet Address: Your public wallet address used to execute transactions.
sections.s1_c3: Technical Data: IP address, device type, and browser information to ensure security.
sections.s1_c4: Communication Data: Any emails or messages you provide when contacting our support team.
sections.s2_c1: End-to-End Encryption: All communication between our app and servers is secured with advanced encryption.
sections.s2_c2: No Private Key Access: Oxford Financial Ads never asks for or stores your wallet private key or seed phrase. Full control of your funds remains with you.
sections.s2_c3: Blockchain Transparency: All transaction records are transparently stored on Arbitrum Explorer and cannot be altered.
sections.s3_c1: To manage your trading account and facilitate transactions.
sections.s3_c2: To enhance platform security and prevent fraud.
sections.s3_c3: To send system updates or important notifications.
sections.s4_c1: Oxford Financial Ads does not sell or rent your personal information or trading data to any third party.
sections.s4_c2: However, technical data may be processed when required by law or for the operation of the blockchain network (such as Arbitrum).
sections.s5_c1: Our website may use small cookies to improve your browsing experience and help you log in faster.
sections.s5_c2: You can disable cookies from your browser settings if you prefer.
sections.s6_c1: Verify information related to your account.
sections.s6_c2: Remove your account from our platform at any time.
sections.s6_c3: Security Tips: Oxford Financial Ads admin will never ask for your password or recovery phrase. Avoid sharing such information with anyone.

terms.noticeText1: By accessing or using Oxford Financial Ads, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. Cryptocurrency trading involves substantial risk and may not be suitable for all investors. You should carefully consider your investment objectives and risk tolerance before using our platform.
terms.noticeText2: Oxford Financial Ads is a technology provider, not a financial advisory firm. Our AI logic is for data analysis only. Please conduct your own market research before investing.
terms.questionsText: If you have any questions about these Terms and Conditions, please contact us:

sections.s1_c1: Market Volatility: Cryptocurrency and trading markets are highly volatile. Although we use AI technology to minimize risk, the value of investments may increase or decrease at any time.
sections.s1_c2: Capital Risk: Investors should understand that trading carries the risk of losing capital as well as making profits. Only surplus or discretionary funds should be invested.
sections.s1_c3: Past Performance: Past results do not guarantee future profits.
sections.s2_c1: Users must be legally adults according to their country laws (generally 18 years or older).
sections.s2_c2: Using the platform for illegal purposes or money laundering is strictly prohibited.
sections.s3_c1: Wallet Security: Oxford Financial Ads is a decentralized platform, and you are fully responsible for your wallet private key and password. If lost, the company cannot recover your funds.
sections.s3_c2: Technical Limitations: Although we use Arbitrum and Offchain Labs robust network, Oxford Financial Ads is not liable for blockchain network failures or network congestion.
sections.s4_c1: Processing Time: Deposits and withdrawals are generally instant, but may be delayed due to network traffic.
sections.s4_c2: Fees: Network gas fees and platform service charges may change over time and will be displayed during the transaction.
sections.s5_c1: If a user engages in scams, hacking attempts, or misuses platform logic, Oxford Financial Ads reserves the right to block the account without prior notice.
sections.s6_c1: Oxford Financial Ads reserves the right to update its rules, trading fees, or platform logic at any time. Major changes will be communicated to the global community in advance.

privacySecurity.description: Oxford Financial Ads dey built on foundation of security, transparency, and user sovereignty. Our security architecture and compliance framework dey make sure say your data and assets remain protected at all times.
privacySecurity.feature1Desc: View the maximum possible profit for each package — e.g., a $100 package progress bar dey show 0 to $150.
privacySecurity.feature2Desc: Upgrade to bigger package anytime by buying the new package.
privacySecurity.feature3Desc: Each package get badge or medal based on im name — e.g., $10 = 'Micro', $100,000 = 'Sovereign'.
privacySecurity.feature4Desc: When profit reach 150%, the package card go show Expired and the withdrawal button go lock until new package dey bought.
privacySecurity.legalNoticeDesc: Oxford Financial Ads dey provide algorithmic trading infrastructure and no dey offer investment advice, financial planning, or portfolio management services. This platform na for sophisticated users wey understand blockchain technology and cryptocurrency market risks. Participation mean say you accept all inherent smart contract, market, technological, and regulatory risks. Consult independent legal, tax, and financial advisors before you join.
privacySecurity.section1Desc: You dey maintain full control of your assets at all times. Oxford Financial Ads dey operate as non-custodial platform where your funds remain inside your wallet under your private key control. Smart contracts dey execute trades according to predefined parameters without third-party custody.
privacySecurity.section2Desc: All strategy executions dey governed by audited smart contracts wey dey deployed on Arbitrum Layer-2. Automated protocols dey handle trade execution, position management, and rebalancing according to algorithmic parameters without human intervention or discretionary control.
privacySecurity.section3Desc: Your connected wallet dey retain withdrawal rights at all times. You fit disconnect, withdraw partial or full balances, and exit strategies according to smart contract parameters. No lock-up periods or withdrawal restrictions beyond standard blockchain confirmation times.
privacySecurity.section4Desc: All projected performance scenarios na simulations based on historical data and algorithmic models. Past performance no dey guarantee future results. Cryptocurrency markets dey very volatile and involve substantial risk of loss. Only allocate capital wey you fit afford to lose.
privacySecurity.title: Global-Standard Privacy:

securityStandards.feature1Desc: At Oxford Financial Ads, your capital and campaign budgets dey remain under your direct control at all times. The platform no dey hold or lock your private keys or advertising funds, we dey make sure 100% transparency and asset security.
securityStandards.feature2Desc: Our advanced data-driven logic dey continuously adapt to market shifts to optimize every advertising campaign. This intelligent distribution dey make sure you achieve maximum returns, visibility, and profitability across all marketing cycles.
securityStandards.feature3Desc: To safeguard your investments against sudden market volatility, our system dey use automated portfolio balancing and dynamic hedging strategies. E dey strategically distribute your ad spend to reduce financial risks and guarantee platform integrity.
securityStandards.feature4Desc: Powered by advanced high-speed infrastructure, your campaigns dey deploy with microsecond-level precision. This dey make sure your target audience dey engaged instantly, so you no go miss high-value business opportunities or lose leads because of slow infrastructure.
